rationale: No rule-specific fmt_basis_spread standard exists in the contract. The flag is CIK-level with n_violate=2 and no row/cell location. Source evidence was readable: the investment fair-value anchor ties to the schedule total at 1,646,959, and targeted SOI rows show unusual spread formats such as E + 5.75% (incl. 2.50% PIK) and SF + 7.50% PIK, but those source rows are internally parseable and do not prove a source data error. Without the two internally flagged rows or an independent source contradiction, raw source does not decide whether the weak check found a real extraction defect or over-fired on valid formatting.
